brief.description: the seat, the last session's note, the ready work, the known traps
brief.template: Run `scripts/brief.sh` and read what it prints. That is your orientation for this session — the seat you are sitting in, the ledger's current state, and anything the last session left behind. opencode has no session-start hook, so this does not run on its own; that is why this command exists.

verify.description: the gate — build and tests behind one exit code
verify.template: Run `scripts/verify.sh`. Report the result. If a step fails, read the full log it names rather than re-running the underlying build command yourself — the gate exists so proving the work costs one line of context instead of ten thousand.

review.description: the standing review pass — taste, correctness, and design
review.template: Run `scripts/review.sh` to build the review packet, then spawn `reviewer-taste` and `reviewer-correctness` against the path it prints, plus `reviewer-design` if anything on screen moved. Fix what is real, file the rest as beads, and say plainly what you left and why.

ready.template: Run `bd ready` and show me what is claimable. If I pick one, claim it with `bd update <id> --claim` before you start implementing.
